neighbours.label: the piece right after in-/all-/non- in a technical compound (in-vitro, in-hospital, all-optical)
fire: Embryos were grown by in-vitro methods at the fertility clinic.
Researchers reported a sharp drop in in-hospital deaths among stroke patients.
The team built an all-optical logic gate from silicon rings.
Mice in the in-vivo group were labelled with a dye.
Engineers favoured a non-optical readout for the new gyroscope.
The field crew carried out in-situ measurements of soil moisture.
Survival was poor after in-hospital cardiac arrest in older adults.
The router relies on all-optical switching between fibres.
quiet: Embryos were grown in a dish at the fertility clinic for three days.
Researchers reported a sharp drop in deaths among stroke patients at the hospital.
The team built an optical logic gate from silicon rings.
Mice in the treated group were labelled with a dye while alive.
Engineers favoured a magnetic readout for the new gyroscope.
The well-trained field crew took long-term measurements of soil moisture.
Survival was poor after cardiac arrest in the hospital in older adults.
The router relies on optical switching between low-cost fibres.

short: piece after in-/all-/non- in technical compounds
